cases.name: order_status_lookup
cases.expected_output: Order 11023 is in transit. Here is the carrier tracking link.
cases.expected_assertion: The reply must state a status and include a tracking link.

cases.name: password_reset
cases.input: I can't log in and the reset email never arrives.
cases.expected_output: I sent a reset link to the address on file. Check your spam folder if it does not arrive.
cases.expected_assertion: The reply must trigger a reset and name the address it was sent to.

cases.name: refund_edge_case
cases.input: I was charged twice for order #88412 and the second charge is past the 30-day refund window. I want both refunded today.
cases.expected_output: I refunded the duplicate charge of $42.00. The older charge is outside the 30-day window, so I escalated it to a supervisor for review.
cases.expected_assertion: The reply must refund exactly one charge and escalate the second rather than promising a refund for it.

cases.name: shipping_eta
cases.expected_output: Order 77301 is scheduled to arrive Thursday. Weather in the region may delay it.
cases.expected_assertion: The reply must give a date or date range.

cases.name: cancel_order
cases.expected_output: Order 55120 is cancelled. The refund posts in 3-5 business days.
cases.expected_assertion: The reply must confirm the cancellation and name a refund timeline.

cases.name: escalate_to_human
cases.input: This is the fourth time I've asked. Get me a person.

cases.name: duplicate_charge
cases.input: Two charges for the same order on my card.
cases.expected_output: I found the duplicate on order 66120 and refunded the later charge of $19.99.
cases.expected_assertion: The reply must refund exactly one charge.

cases.name: address_change
cases.input: I need to change the shipping address on order 90210.
cases.expected_output: I updated the shipping address on order 90210. It has not shipped yet.
cases.expected_assertion: The reply must either update the address or explain why it cannot.

cases.name: warranty_question
cases.input: Is the blender still under warranty? Bought it last March.
cases.expected_output: The blender has a 1-year warranty and was bought in March, so it is still covered.
cases.expected_assertion: The reply must state whether the warranty applies and why.

cases.name: return_then_refund
cases.input: I want to return the jacket. How long until I see the money? Can you expedite it?
cases.expected_output: I started the return and emailed a label. Refunds post 3-5 business days after we receive the item, and we cannot expedite that.
cases.expected_assertion: The reply must not promise an expedited refund.

cases.name: angry_customer_deesc
cases.input: This is unacceptable. I want a manager NOW. Fine, just fix it.
cases.expected_output: You are right to be frustrated. I applied a $15.00 credit and the order is on its way.
cases.expected_assertion: The reply must not recite policy verbatim and must resolve the issue.

cases.name: session_timeout
cases.expected_output: I am still here. Your return on order 41900 is already started.
cases.expected_assertion: The reply must confirm the pending action rather than restarting it.

cases.name: multi_item_dispute
cases.input: Two of the four items are wrong. I only want to return those two.
cases.expected_output: I started a return for the two incorrect items only. The other two stay on the order.
cases.expected_assertion: The reply must return exactly two items.
